title: hippeastrum × johnsonii
intro: Hippeastrum × johnsonii, commonly known as the Johnson's Amaryllis or Johnson's Fire Lily, is a hybrid plant of the Amaryllidaceae family. It is known for its vibrant red or orange trumpet-shaped flowers and is often grown in gardens and indoor spaces for its ornamental value. The Johnson's Amaryllis has been found to have potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing inflammation and fighting infections. The bioactive constituents of Hippeastrum × johnsonii include alkaloids, such as galantamine and homoharpagide, which have been shown to have potential therapeutic effects.
